replication_check.reading: Pearson-minus-CE gaps at lambda = 0.01 should reproduce the preregistered 300-iteration run (same penalty function); the MSE gaps should NOT, because the ridge form changed (0.5 N lambda on X'X instead of lambda).

P1_binary_matched_gap.rule: on every binary view the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003

P2_raw_gap_positive_signal_raw.rule: seed-mean raw gap positive on at least 90% of signal views (primary: signal = seed-mean (constant minus CE-trained head, raw) > 0)

P2_raw_gap_positive_signal_strict.rule: seed-mean raw gap positive on at least 90% of signal views (strict: calibrated CE-trained head beats constant with the interval above 0 on >= 3 of 5 seeds)

P3_K3plus_matched_gap.rule: for K of 3 or more the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003 on at least 80% of views; refuted if a K >= 3 view has a gap above 0.005 with the interval above 0 on at least 3 of 5 seeds

P5_strata.rule: in both entropy strata the seed-mean raw gap is positive and the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003
